title: Marine Weather Warning Tracker: NWS Alerts by Area
description: Check for active marine hazard alerts (Small Craft Advisory, Gale Warning, Storm Warning, Coastal Flood, High Surf, and more) from the official NOAA/National Weather Service feed, filtered by US coastal state.
